entities.description: Acting/only physician after Roeder's death; investigator.
Dead head physician; ran the secret 'method'; found in locked room.
Head nurse; keeps the doses; burned a chart; survives all limbs.
False-name patient ('Madame Surel'); sister of the buried Surel; murderer on the escalate line.
Hélène's brother; a spent method-subject; six years in the house ground.
Stockholm engineer; the second patient; false 'improving' chart; dies on escalate.
The steward; keeps the keys, the warden's board, the maintenance log.
The green morphine ledger; grains signed out under Roeder's hand.
House master key on the warden's board in Gaspard's office.
Roeder's private key, found inside the bolted room.
The unlabelled brown bottle of strong morphia, a third gone.
Roeder's brass-locked diary.
Roeder's unsent resignation to the Berne board, halting on 'conscience'.
The last telegram (Aigle resupply) before the line went dead.
Hélène's forged admission papers (false Lausanne referral).
The funicular maintenance log, chained to Gaspard's desk, with a blank day.
Lindqvist's chart, abruptly written 'improving'.
The old kept-alive case folder, burned in the stove.
Lindqvist's boots, snow-wet and packed at the toe.
The admission/patient register.
The leather-bound book of the dead.
Roeder's secret evening 'method': morphia injections to the favoured cases.
The snowed-in sanatorium, former Hôtel Belvoir.
Roeder's bolted consulting room (east wing).
Brandt's dispensary of labelled drawers.
Gaspard's office with the warden's board.
The cellar archive of discharged charts.
Hélène's well-kept lower-floor room.
Belvoir's own consecrated ground.
The funicular/cable down to Aigle.
